messages:
sam: Hey @maya — congrats on the new PM hire! :tada: Pasting a compact manager-first-week checklist and a 30/60/90 starter you can adapt. Keep this thread for any access hiccups.

sam: Quick TL;DR: Day0 = access + equipment; Day1 = 1:1 + team intro; Days 2-5 = product ramp, stakeholder syncs, and first project alignment.

sam: Manager checklist (short):
• Confirm laptop + accessories shipped and IME logged
• Request VPN + Okta group (IT: it-requests@)
• Calendar invites: Day1 1:1 (30m), Team intro (30m), Buddy sync (15m)
• Add to relevant Slack channels and Confluence spaces
• Share role goals + 30/60/90 draft by EOW

maya: Thanks Sam! A couple Qs: 1) Laptop ETA? 2) Do we have an approved 30/60/90 template or should I make one?

onboard-bot: Hi — laptop is marked shipped (order #RD-98421). ETA Wed 10am PT. VPN invite pending until IT group is assigned. See /onboard status: https://redwood.internal/onboard/98421

alex: @maya i've assigned @lisa as the buddy for the first 2 weeks. She'll do morning standups Tue/Thu for the first week.

lisa: happy to help! :wave: I'll send a 15m "first-day walkthrough" invite — quick product tour + dev tools.

jordan: Team intro: Wed 10-10:30am works for eng. I'll book the room and add a short demo slot for current sprint.

maya: Perfect. Sam — could you drop a copy of the 30/60/90 sample here? Also any recommended first-week reading (docs or tickets)?

sam: Sure — pasted below (feel free to copy/edit). Also add: product RFCs, top 5 customer tickets, and API overview during week 1.

sam: ```
30/60/90 template (example)
30 days:
- Learn the product, customers, and team processes
- Complete onboarding checklists and dev access
- Deliver 1 small scoped task (bugfix or doc) to understand flow
60 days:
- Take ownership of a small feature or experiment
- Start regular stakeholder syncs and report progress
- Propose 1 improvement to onboarding or telemetry
90 days:
- Lead rollout plan for a feature or experiment
- Measure impact and iterate on outcomes
- Define success metrics for the next quarter
```

sam: Calendar blurbs you can paste into invites:
"Day1 1:1 — Welcome + role expectations. Bring questions and your calendar. 30m."
"Team intro — quick intros, responsibilities, and current priorities. 30m."

maya: Nice, thanks. One more: what's expected from managers in week 1 re: hiring pipeline and 30/60/90? Should I share the draft publicly or keep internal?

sam: Best practice: share a private draft with your manager and skip-level (if applicable) by EOD Friday; publish a short 30-day public milestone in Confluence for transparency. If you want a reviewer, ping me and i'll do a quick pass.

alex: IT checklist for you, @maya: submit the Okta group request (link: https://redwood.internal/okta-requests), cc team-security. If any SSO issues, file a ticket and tag #eng-oncall.

maya: Will do. Also flagging potential access issue: new hire's GitHub org invite didn't go through earlier today. @jordan can you re-invite?

jordan: On it — re-invited and set to "member". If they still can't see private repos, we'll add them directly to the team.

lisa: FYI i'll run through the developer onboarding checklist Wed morning (where we test local env, git, and token access). I'll post the test commands in #dev-experience.

sam: Final note for managers: plan 30min check-ins on Day2 and Day5 (short, to surface blockers). If the new hire still has >2 access blockers after Day1, escalate to People Ops.

maya: Great — i have what I need. I'll draft and share the 30/60/90 by Friday and set up the invites. Thanks team! :raised_hands:

sam: Awesome — ping here if anything stalls. :white_check_mark:
